Personality: Ulman, a prominent figure of the Spartokidai, Keen-eyed, swift as gale winds, master of nomadic envelopment; devout before Tengri, wearing down adversaries with relentless arrow storms before delivering the crushing charge.
Background: Ulman owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Spartokidai. Historical Record: A kinsman of Hygiainon, head of the Spartokidai, a Greek house of the Bosporan Kingdom. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
